```yaml
name: Unit Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [staging]
  pull_request:
    branches: [staging]

jobs:
  unit-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run unit tests with coverage
        id: test
        run: |
          npm test -- --coverage --coverageReporters=json-summary --json --outputFile=jest-results.json
        continue-on-error: false

      - name: Upload coverage artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-report
          path: coverage
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Parse test and coverage results
        id: results
        run: |
          echo "Parsing coverage summary..."
          FUNCTIONS=$(jq -r '.total.functions.pct' coverage/coverage-summary.json)
          LINES=$(jq -r '.total.lines.pct' coverage/coverage-summary.json)
          PASSED=$(jq -r '.numPassedTests' jest-results.json)
          FAILED=$(jq -r '.numFailedTests' jest-results.json)
          TOTAL=$(jq -r '.numTotalTests' jest-results.json)
          echo "functions=$FUNCTIONS" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "lines=$LINES" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "passed=$PASSED" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "failed=$FAILED" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "total=$TOTAL" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
        shell: bash

      - name: Post test results comment
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const functions = '${{ steps.results.outputs.functions }}';
            const lines = '${{ steps.results.outputs.lines }}';
            const passed = '${{ steps.results.outputs.passed }}';
            const failed = '${{ steps.results.outputs.failed }}';
            const total = '${{ steps.results.outputs.total }}';
            const testsPassed = failed == 0 ? '✅' : '❌';
            const commentBody = `
            ### Unit Test Results
            - **Tests**: ${testsPassed} (${passed}/${total} passed, ${failed} failed)
            - **Coverage**: Functions ${functions}%, Lines ${lines}%
            - [Coverage Report](${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }})
            `;
            const { data: { pull_request } } = context.issue;
            if (pull_request) {
              await github.rest.issues.createComment({
                ...context.repo,
                issue_number: pull_request.number,
                body: commentBody
              });
            }
```
